title: Neutral late-year versus central aggregate mean revenue loss

claims.text: The neutral late-year scenario produces a slightly lower mean aggregate revenue loss than the central scenario; this is a sensitivity comparison reflecting the neutral late-year assumption, not a causal attribution or an estimate of the probability of that scenario occurring.

limitations: Scenario names are labels, not ratios to the fitted central parameters; actual values were read from the scenario metadata.
Sensitivity alternatives are not assigned occurrence probabilities and do not define a calibrated credible interval.
Values are modeled conditional means for the all-modeled aggregate and should not be compared to country-level quantiles or summed across countries.
